description: Change a picture's pixel size: by percent, or to a width and/or height (the shape kept unless fit is exact or cover). Free, with a daily limit per account. Give the file through get_upload_link (file_id) or a public link. The result link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, GIF, BMP or TIFF) there.

file_url.description: Or a public https link to the picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, GIF, BMP or TIFF). A result link from another YangOpen tool works too.

fit.description: contain: fit inside the size, keeping the shape. cover: fill it and crop the overflow. exact: stretch.

percent.description: Scale, like 50 for half. Give this, or width/height.

name: resize_image
title: Resize a picture
